items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: I had a brother, John. He was a good drummer.

ctx.x: People tell me that too. It was a popular band, that tuxedo. Popular. I just kept on straight.

They didn't really like it. Some of them used to fuss with me. Some night when they get up, that guy said, you have to get to play and say, I'm hungry. I said, you're hungry? I said, didn't you know you were just coming with the white? And then he didn't know. I said, you need to tell me you can't go about two hours and a half before you're in the mission or three hours or something. He said, no, get out. He said, once more, no slas. He said, no slas. He said, you're in the mission. They get hot with me. But I'm…
What did they pay for dances?
